title: Trial of Offences under Consumer Protection Act

content.scenario: A consumer files a complaint against a company for violating the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. The District Commission tries the offence summarily.
content.outcome: The District Commission will try the offence summarily, as per the provisions of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. The Commission will hear the case and pass an order accordingly.

user_queries: How are offences under the Consumer Protection Act tried?
What is the role of the District Commission in trying offences?
What is a summary trial in the context of consumer protection?
